falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that pattern resolved with lower lows; this confirms bull continuation not bottoming structure

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.50 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained complacency contradicts bottom formation dynamics; the pattern requires elevated/falling-from-elevated volatility, not pre-crash calm

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and DXY simultaneously breaks below 100.00
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Dual flight-to-safety/rate-cut panic without equity follow-through indicates macro regime shift (recession pricing), invalidating the tactical bottom call which assumes stabilization not acceleration

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
